senses.gloss:
अनूक (कः) 1.
m. A former state of
existence.
n. Race; disposi-
tion.

अनु-कर्ष (षः) 1.
m. Bottom of a car-
riage; incantation; attraction.

अनु-कर्षण (णं) 1.
n. Invoking by in-
cantation; attraction.

अनु-कर्षन् (षा) 5.
m. The bottom of
a carriage; incantation, &c.

अनु-कल्प (ल्पः)
m. A secondary in-
junction; an alternative.

अनु-कामीन (नः) 1.
m. One who lives
as he lists, or does as he likes.

अनु-कारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Imita-
ting, following, resembling.

अनु-कूल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Friendly.
m. A faithful husband.
f. Croton
polyandrum.
n. Kindness.

अनु-क्रमण (णं) 1.
n. Proceeding or-
derly or progressively.

अनु-क्रमणिका (का) 1.
f. Table of
contents; index; list.

अनु-ग (गः-गा-गं)
a. Following.
m.
A servant, a husband.

अनु-गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Followed; fol-
lowing; obtained.

अनु-गम (मः) 1.
m. Following, dying
after the husband, as a widow.

अनु-गम्य (म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
a. Worthy of
imitation, or of being followed.

अनु-गुण (णः-णा-णं)
a. According to
the merit, or qualities.

अनुच्छ्वास (सः) 1.
m. Suppression of
the breath. R. श्वस्

अनुज (जः) 1.
m. A younger
brother. Also अनुजातः अनुजम्मा.

अनु-ज्ञा (ज्ञा) 1.
f. An order, com-
mand, permission.

अनु-तप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
par. Heated by
fire or by grief and regret.

अनुत्तर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Chief.
n. An
evasive answer or reply.

अनु-तर्षण (णं) 1.
n. A vessel from
which spirituous liquor is drunk.

अनु-तापिन् (पी-पिनी-पि)
a. Peni-
tent, grieving for the past.

अनुत्ता_न (नः-ना-नं)
a. Lying with
the face to the ground.

अनुत्सूत्र (त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
a. According to
rule or not opposed to it.

अनुद्ध_त (तः-ता-तं)
a. Humble; un-
opposed; firm.

अनुद्रुत (तं) 1.
n. A measure of
time in music, half a
druta,
quarter of a
mātrā. a. (तः-ता-तं)
Pursued.

अनु-नय (यः) 1.
m. Salutation, re-
spect; regulation of conduct.

अनु-नयिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Cour-
teous, respectful; humble.

अनूप (पः) 1.
m. A buffalo.
a. Wet.

आनूप (पः) 1.
n. Any animals living
in marshy places.

अनुप-कारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Neg-
lectful, not helping, ungrateful.

अनुप-पत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Failure in ar-
gument; failure.

अनुप-मेय (यः-या-यं)
a. Incompara-
ble, beyond comparison.

अनुप-लम्भन (नं) 1.
n. Want of ap-
prehension or knowledge.

अनुप-शय (यः) 1.
m. Aggravation
of a disease or complaint.

अनु-पात (तः) 1.
m. Proceeding; a
degree of latitude; proportion.

अनु-पान (नं) 1.
n. A fluid vehicle
in medicine.

अनु-पुष्प (ष्पः) 1.
m. A kind of reed.

अनु-प्रास (सः) 1.
m. A kind of al-
teration or repetition of letters.

अनु-बन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A characteris-
tic letter affixed to a verb.

अनु-बोध (धः) 1.
m. A perfum-
ing; an after-thought.

अनु-भव (वः) 1.
m. Apprehen-
sion, judgment, experience.

अनु-भाव (बः) 1.
m. Indication of
passion; firm opinion; experi-
ence.

अनु-भूत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Known, per-
ceived, apprehended.

अनु-भूत-वाच् (क्)
a. Known to
speak the truth always.

अनु-मति (तिः) 2.
f. An order; 15th
day of the moon's age.

अनु-मन्तृ (न्ता) 4.
m. One who con-
sents or agrees with another.

अनु-मरण (णं) 1.
n. Dying after.
Burning after the dead husband,
and not with him.

अनु-मा (मा) 1.
f. Inference.
Also अनु-मानं अनुमितिः

अनु-यायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Follow-
ing, consequent upon.

अनु-योगकृत् (कृत्) 5.
m. A spiritual
teacher. Also अनुयोक्तृ

अनु-रति (तिः क्तिः) 2.
f. Love, pas-
sion. Also अनुरक्तिः अनु-रागः

अनु-रस (सः) 1.
m. A secondary
flavour or taste.

अनु-रागिन् (गी-गिणी-गि)
a. Sub-
ject to passion, loving.

अनु-राधा (धा) 1.
f. The 17th lunar
mansion, stars in Libra.

अनु-रोध (धः) 1.
m. Obliging, com-
plaisance, service.

अनु-लोमज (जः-जा-जं)
a. Produced
in due gradation.

अनु-वर्त्तन (नं) 1.
n. Obliging ano-
ther; result or consequence.

अनु-वाक (कः) 1.
m. Chapter or
compilation of the Vedas.

अनु-वाद (दः) 1.
m. Abuse; coinci-
dence; tautology.

अनु-वाद्य (द्यं) 1.
n. Subject of a
predicate.
a. Conformable.

अनु-वासन (नं) 1.
n. Affection; per-
fuming, fumigation.

अनु-व्रजन (नं) 1.
n. Following a
guest a short distance.

*अनुव्रत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Following,
imitating.
m. An attendant.

अनु-शय (यः) 1.
m. Repentance; en-
mity. (यी) 3.
f. A pimple.

अनु-शासन (नं) 1.
n. Order, law.
Also अनुशास्तिः
f.

अनु-षङ्गिन् (ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
a. Con-
nected with, attached to.

अनु-ष्ठान (नं) 1.
n. Course of pro-
ceeding; doing; fixing; fitness.

अनु-स्मृति (तिः) 2.
f. Cherished re-
collection of particular ideas.

अनु-हार्य्य (य्यः) 1.
m. Monthly ob-
sequies, or offerings to the dead.

अनू-चान (नः) 1.
m. A learned
brāhman.
a. Well behaved.

अनूद्य (द्यः) 1.
m. A spiritual teacher.
a. Not to be spoken to.

अनूरु (रुः) 2.
m. Charioteer of the
sun, the dawn.
a. Thighless.

आनु-मानिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Inferri-
ble, deducible from.

आनु-षङ्गिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Connected,
analogous, necessary; elliptical^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

*आनु-षङ्गिक (कः-का-कं)
a. Implied;
necessarily following as a con-
sequence; inevitable.

अनुकाल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Occasional.
adv. At different times.

अनुक्षीयमाण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Wasting
or wasted away.

अनुग्रह-कातर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Anxious
to please or favour.

अनुनिर्जहान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Proceed-
ed out of.

अनु-पथ (थः-था-थं)
a. Following.
m. A way.

अनुपलक्ष्य-वर्त्मन् (र्त्मा-र्त्मा-र्त्म)
a. Whose
ways are unsearchable.

अनुमरिष्यत् (न्-न्ती-त्)
a. About to
follow in death.

अनुमृग्यदाशुस् (शुः) 5.
m. Granting
all that is sought; prayer-an-
swering.

अनुरक्त-प्रज (जः-जा-जं)
a. Beloved by his subjects.

आनुश्रविक (कः)
a. According to
the hearing.
